corrections.corrected_reference_text: Load balancing is a technique that distributes traffic across multiple servers to protect applications from a single point of failure and improve performance.

corrections.corrected_reference_text: Bash is a shell used to execute commands on Linux and Unix-like operating systems.

corrections.corrected_reference_text: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime environment that enables JavaScript code to run on the server side.

corrections.corrected_reference_text: A peer-to-peer network allows users to connect directly and share files or data without a central server.
corrections.rationale: Peer-to-peer 개념을 네트워크 실체와 바로 동일시하는 어색한 구조를 피하면서 원문의 직접 연결·공유 의미를 보존한다.

corrections.corrected_reference_text: Cloud computing is used in a wide range of fields, including software development, data analytics, and machine learning.
